content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Marietta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a specific combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the prerequisites. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can answer questions about your background and help you verify qualification before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Marietta-based instructors deliver the required formal education on a schedule that fits working professionals. Attend all sessions, participate actively, and complete coursework to earn your training certificate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI with your training certificate and professional experience documentation. Pay the PMI exam registration fee through their portal. Processing typically takes several business days. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the application workflow and answer procedural questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to strengthen your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in the Marietta area at your preferred date. Sit for the computer-based PMP® exam and submit your answers.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you earn the PMP® credential and must renew it every three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and practical project work. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing certification maintenance and career growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
